shared_context.topic: taking a lower dose of sertraline while taking ondansetron (Zofran)
shared_context.condition: potential interaction with increased risk of serotonin syndrome

snippets.output: There is no direct interaction between sertraline and ondansetron (Zofran) that necessitates a dose adjustment of sertraline.
snippets.pattern_notes: Two atoms stating the same fact (no interaction / no dose adjustment) — parallel properties of the drug pair.

snippets.output: Both sertraline and ondansetron can increase the risk of serotonin syndrome, which is characterized by symptoms such as confusion, rapid heart rate, and high blood pressure.
snippets.pattern_notes: Risk claim plus enumeration of characterizing symptoms of serotonin syndrome — properties of one subject.

snippets.output: It is important to monitor for symptoms of serotonin syndrome when sertraline and ondansetron are taken together.
Consult your healthcare provider before making any changes to your medication regimen. They can provide personalized advice based on your medical history and current condition.
snippets.pattern_notes: Recommendation to consult provider supported by reasons (personalized advice based on history and condition).
